criteria.requirement: The first turn lacks callback and command declarations. First state that the root cause cannot yet be determined, and request registration code or root/subcommand help that distinguishes option ownership. Conditional hypotheses are allowed, but do not assert the root cause in advance.
After valid disclosure, confirm that --verbose belongs to the root callback and export does not declare this option. Do not continue refusing to diagnose or repeatedly request the same material.

Provide python shop.py --verbose export, and explain that root parameters are parsed first and the subcommand receives a separate context. Conclude that the current fixture shows normal behavior; do not attribute every similar error to this cause.
Do not recommend a nonexistent global-option switch or modify the application or Typer. Asking for clarification in the first turn alone does not complete the entire diagnostic task.

disclosure_rules.before_disclosure: Only disclose or a justified incomplete result is allowed; a direct pass is not allowed.
disclosure_rules.after_disclosure: A pass is allowed only after all necessary conditions are satisfied.
disclosure_rules.help_request: A request for root or subcommand help also permits disclosure of the same complete registration code to establish option ownership. Do not fabricate help output.
